What you can do

Built around your routine.

01

Your plan, in one place

Record a quit date, step-down plan and daily limits, with a clear view of the information you enter.

02

Make each check-in count

Log daily use, view streaks and milestones, and see estimates based on your entries.

03

Build a daily routine

Use check-in reminders and a home-screen widget to stay connected with your personal progress.

For adults of legal age. This app provides personal tracking and general information. It does not provide medical advice or emergency care.
